verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice handles recurring invoices and stored cards, so a subscription-migration story fairly applies. However, the evidence pack documents no import from spreadsheets or competing platforms and no PCI-compliant card-data transfer. The general PCI-DSS compliance claim and card storage for recurring charges are adjacent features, not a migration capability.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can migrate live subscriptions in from a spreadsheet or a competing platform — including PCI-compliant card data transfer — without customers noticing
